notice: These are estimates built from traveller reports and published fees, not quotes. Matthew is still confirming with the ferry operators and the boat companies. Budget off them, but verify your own before you book.

outbound.label: Charlotte Amalie → Road Town
outbound.note: Three companies rotate the slots. Buy at the terminal — tickets are non-refundable if you miss one.

ferrySchedule.bufferNote: Bags, taxi to the terminal and buying a ticket. An arrival less than 75 minutes before a sailing doesn't realistically make it.
ferrySchedule.checkinNote: Time needed on the St. Thomas side between stepping off the ferry and your flight: taxi to the airport, bag drop, security.

ferry.label: Public ferry

rows.label: Ferry fare
rows.sub: per couple, round trip, with bags

rows.label: BVI levy, departure tax, USVI port fee

ferry.sharedNote: Road Town Fast Ferry runs Charlotte Amalie to Road Town direct. Smith's and Native Son rotate the other slots and have been intermittent — check the day before.

watertaxi.label: Private boat
watertaxi.sharedNote: Priced per boat, 5–8 passengers. Split four ways it lands about $250 above the ferry. One couple booking alone pays the whole boat — roughly $1,700 round trip.

rows.label: Taxi, STT airport → marina
rows.sub: Red Hook or Crown Bay, both ways

operators.name: The Last Mile
operators.sub: 45 min Red Hook → Nanny Cay, customs cleared aboard

operators.name: Island Time BVI
operators.sub: land taxi from STT included, monitors flights

fees.note: Per person. Levy is charged on arrival in the BVI by air or sea. The $20 departure tax applies when you leave the BVI by ferry; leaving by air it's $50 and is normally in the ticket.
